description: Create an empty label design, or one based on a gallery template. To save design content you authored yourself, use create_design_from_json instead — it validates the content first. Returns the design ID and URLs for the designer, viewer, and thumbnail.

isPublic.description: Whether the design is publicly viewable (default true)

templateId.description: Gallery template ID to start from (e.g. "itf14-case-code"). Call list_templates for current ids.

name: create_design
title: Create Design
